project_type: Texora — offline desktop OCR app. Monorepo: Tauri v2 (Rust) + React 18/TS/Vite shell (apps/desktop), Python 3.11 FastAPI engine sidecar (engine/). pnpm workspace; the desktop package is named 'desktop' (root scripts use --filter desktop).
build_system: Frontend: pnpm (workspace). Engine: pip into engine/.venv (Python 3.11.9). Rust: cargo via Tauri. QUIRK: a PATH export is required before EVERY shell command (see environment_constraints). QUIRK: Rust builds need the MSVC env loaded first — run cargo inside a cmd.exe session that calls vcvars64.bat (VS 2022 Build Tools + Windows 10 SDK are installed); bash does not inherit LIB/INCLUDE/PATH.
test_framework: Engine: pytest (engine/tests, asyncio_mode=strict). Frontend: vitest (jsdom). Rust: cargo test (unit tests in src/*.rs #[cfg(test)]).
build_command: Engine: engine/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m <tool> run from engine/. Frontend: pnpm --filter desktop build (from worktree root). Rust: cargo build (from apps/desktop/src-tauri, vcvars64 loaded).
test_command: Engine (from engine/): engine/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest -q. Frontend (from root): pnpm --filter desktop test -- --run. Rust (from apps/desktop/src-tauri, vcvars64): cargo test.
verification_instructions: Per task.md and steering: after any change run the relevant stack's build+lint+tests. Engine gate: ruff check . ; black --check . --line-length 100 ; mypy texora_engine ; pytest -q (all run from engine/ with the venv python). Frontend gate: pnpm --filter desktop lint ; pnpm --filter desktop test -- --run ; pnpm --filter desktop build. Rust gate (vcvars64 loaded, cwd apps/desktop/src-tauri): cargo fmt --check ; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings ; cargo test. OCR-affecting completion must additionally pass the benchmark smoke per steering once the real model is fetched. Append real command output to docs/m2-verification.md (mirror docs/m1-verification.md); record host/interactive items as honestly PENDING, never claimed passed. Clean up temp files.
snapshot_or_generated_files: pnpm-lock.yaml (updated by pnpm install), apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock (updated by cargo). The frozen engine sidecar at apps/desktop/src-tauri/binaries/texora-engine-*.exe is gitignored (regenerate with scripts/build_engine.py). engine/texora_engine/ensemble/katex_allowlist.json is GENERATED by scripts/gen_katex_allowlist.py from the pinned katex (record the input path + any vendored-tarball SHA in docs/m2-verification.md). Model weights are downloaded under models_dir and are NOT committed. Do NOT commit model weights or large binaries.
environment_constraints: Prepend before EVERY shell command: export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/Python/Python311:$LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/Python/Python311/Scripts:$LOCALAPPDATA/Microsoft/WinGet/Packages/pnpm.pnpm_Microsoft.Winget.Source_8wekyb3d8bbwe:$PATH". Worktree is c:\data\kucing\texora\.worktrees\m2-formula-ocr — pass this ABSOLUTE path to every read/git/build command; the default cwd is the MAIN workspace, NOT the worktree, so relative paths land in the wrong tree. Engine work uses engine/.venv/Scripts/python.exe. Rust needs vcvars64.bat loaded in a cmd.exe session. Never start long-running dev servers/watchers via automation (no pnpm dev / pnpm tauri dev); the user runs those manually. Global hotkey, live screen capture, and the on-screen popup are host/interactive — structurally testable only; live behavior is documented pending manual confirmation, never faked.
contribution_requirements: Pin every dependency version; verify each against official docs (PyPI/npm/crates.io) before use — do not invent APIs or hashes. Add a docs/LICENSES.md row in the SAME change that adds a dep or model. Permissive-first: shipped defaults must be Apache/MIT/BSD; Surya/PyMuPDF/AGPL are opt-in only, never default. No placeholder/stub code or fabricated outputs in production paths; NO mocked OCR outside tests. Small, testable units; each ships with tests and passes lint/type checks. Fail gracefully per-item. Conventional-commit messages; small focused commits; commit locally on the branch, NEVER push. Do NOT commit model weights or large binaries.
key_patterns: Engine: full type hints, mypy strict clean, black line-length 100, ruff (E,F,I,W,UP,B). Pydantic v2 for all API I/O and config; no untyped dicts across module boundaries. FastAPI routers: open routes on health_router, token-protected routes on protected_router (dependencies=[Depends(require_token)]) — see engine/texora_engine/api/routes.py and app.py. Auth via secrets.compare_digest in security.py; expected token on app.state.engine_token. Structured rotating logger (logging_config.py); no bare print. Engine adapters implement the Protocol in recognizers/base.py and register in the factory keyed by a stable id — UI/API never name a concrete engine; selection via pipeline.yaml. SQLite only through db/; no raw SQL in routes. RecognitionStatus StrEnum (ok/needs_review/failed) is the single shared state, mirrored as a TS union. Rust: cargo fmt + clippy clean; supervisor.rs is a thin process manager (token/port/spawn/health/backoff), lib.rs registers commands in generate_handler! and emits engine://* events — keep business logic out of Rust. Frontend: strict TS, no any; engineClient.ts is the ONLY module importing invoke/listen and makes NO fetch (grep-enforced); all strings via i18next (id default + en, key parity enforced by a test); functional components + hooks; accessibility keyboard-first/ARIA.
